Contact

Have a correction, suggestion, or question about the site? We want to hear it.

Important note

Social Security Bronx is NOT the Social Security Administration. We cannot help with your individual Social Security account, applications, benefits, or any official transactions. For those, you must contact the SSA directly:

  • SSA national line: 1-800-772-1213 (TTY 1-800-325-0778)
  • Online: ssa.gov
  • the Bronx SSA office: 820 Concourse Village West, Bronx, NY 10451

Site feedback

For corrections, suggestions, or questions about this website only, reach us at: hello@socialsecuritybronx.com

Please do not send personal information such as your Social Security number. We cannot help with individual SSA matters and any such information will be deleted unread.
